_comment: Synthetic, anonymised sample data for Project 027. No real person, email address or phone number appears here. All names are invented and all addresses use the reserved example.com domain.

messages.body: Hello, I am interested in the MSc in Data Analytics. My goal is to move from a reporting role into a proper data science position within the next two years. I have completed a BSc in Statistics and I am currently working as a business analyst with 4 years of experience. I would prefer to study online part-time because I cannot leave my job. Weekday evenings after 7pm and Saturday mornings work best for me, roughly 12 hours a week. I am based in Manchester. Could you tell me when the next intake starts?

Following up on my enquiry. I would like to start in the January intake if there is still space. My budget is around £9,000 and my employer may sponsor part of it, so an instalment plan would help. Best way to reach me is WhatsApp in the evenings. What documents do I need for the application?
Hi, please send me more information about your courses. Thanks.
How much are the fees for the MBA? Is there an EMI option or any scholarship available? I am self-funding so cost matters a lot to me.
Also is the MBA accredited? And roughly what salary do graduates get afterwards?

Good morning. I want to switch careers into cyber security. I am currently working as an IT support technician and I have 6 years of experience, plus a diploma in Computer Science. I am looking at your cyber security bootcamp. I can only study at weekends because of shift work. I live in Krakow and my time zone is CET. When does the next cohort begin and how long is it?

Hi! I saw your advert for the digital marketing certificate and I am very keen. I want to start as soon as possible, ideally within 4 weeks. Is it online? Please call me after 5pm, that is the best time to reach me.

Called to ask about the project management postgraduate diploma. My aim is to get a promotion to programme manager at work. I hold a BA in Business Studies and I am currently working as a project coordinator.
Thank you for your call today. I have attached the programme outline as discussed. Please let me know your preferred start date and study pattern.

Thanks for sending that over. I would like to begin in March 2027. I can manage about 8 hours a week, mostly Tuesday and Thursday evenings. I am based in Leeds. I still need to check the cost with my manager before committing.
I am a 42 year old married woman with two children and I am worried I am too old to retrain. I would like to study nursing on campus. Is there an evening option? I am based in Valencia.

Dear Admissions, I would like to apply for the MSc in Artificial Intelligence. My goal is to become a machine learning engineer and eventually relocate to Europe. I completed a BTech in Computer Science in 2023 and I have 2 years of experience as a software developer. My budget is approximately INR 15 lakh and I am exploring an education loan. I can study full-time on campus and I am ready to join the September 2027 intake. My time zone is IST. What is the application deadline, and is IELTS required?
do you do accounting courses? how much

Hello, I am enquiring about the MSc in Supply Chain Management. I am currently working as a logistics planner and my background is in industrial engineering. I would like to upskill so I can move into a regional operations role. I prefer a hybrid format, around 10 hours a week, and I am available on Mondays and Wednesdays. Email is best for contacting me.
One more thing - is the programme recognised in Germany? I am based in Hamburg.
